subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Do both fallback GitHub App installations intentionally grant repository Contents: Read, and should that requirement be enforced before merging this workflow change?
rationale: The repository YAML can request the scope but cannot prove the external fallback App installations grant it; the successful primary runs do not exercise the fallback condition.

options.title: Verify fallback access before merge
options.body: Confirm the fallback App installation permissions or run each workflow with the primary token path disabled and retain the explicit scope declarations.

options.title: Accept untested fallback behavior
options.body: Merge based on the successful primary paths while accepting that automation may fail during a primary-App outage if fallback access is not configured.

recommendation.title: Verify fallback access before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the fallback App installation permissions or run each workflow with the primary token path disabled and retain the explicit scope declarations.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository automation account is the only evidence-backed routing contact in the supplied workflow and timeline context; a human owner of the App installations should make the final confirmation.
